subject: C41
required_fixes: R1 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:111-127: followed retains the selected request ID when the collection closes, while doc is cleared. Reopening that collection with its persisted selection skips openRequest and leaves the editor blank. Reproduced with the actual component: URL present initially, absent after close/reopen, selected GET list tab still present, openRequest count unchanged. Reset or scope selection-following to the collection lifecycle. Acceptance: close/reopen the same collection restores its selected document and URL, with regression coverage retaining the existing stale-snapshot/new-draft protection.

R2 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/request-tree.tsx:86-123: folders render independently and collapsed hides only direct request rows. Collapsing products leaves products/runtime and its requests visible; the parent also reports zero when its requests are all descendants. This breaks the frozen prototype's hierarchical visibility and counts for nested collections, including the built-in catalogue. Reproduced through RequestTree with nested folders. Acceptance: collapsing any ancestor hides its entire subtree, folder counts include descendant requests, and search can still find requests inside collapsed folders; cover nested folders in component tests.

R3 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/api-client.tsx:132-141,203-205 and tools-sheet.tsx:33-36: opening a tools sheet removes its focused menu-item opener. Modal captures BODY as the opener, so closing Environments returns focus to BODY instead of Collection. Reproduced through ApiClient with real Modal and user-event. This violates I8 and T09 focus restoration. Preserve an explicit surviving return target. Acceptance: opening each collection tool by keyboard and closing by Escape or its close control restores focus to Collection, verified in component tests and native acceptance.

R4 [P2] apps/desktop/src/v2/workbench/request-editor.tsx:329-336: clearing status depends only on the dirty boolean changing. Edit a saved request, Send without saving, then edit again: dirty stays true and the old completion remains instead of Unsaved changes. An in-memory component reproduction ended with visible 'list · 200 · 42 ms' and data-state='unsaved'. Reset completed-action status on subsequent input changes while preserving in-flight status and the initial completion announcement. Acceptance: cover sends from already-dirty and new documents followed by further edits.
evidence_gaps: E1: tools/native-acceptance/acceptance_c41.py:352-365 records opening/docking/closing Environments but never asserts returned focus; N02 exercises only URL-to-Send keyboard traversal. No retained native result establishes tools-sheet focus restoration required by I8/T09. After R3, retain source-bound keyboard open/close AX evidence showing focus restored to Collection.
